choices.content: The road passes through the interior of the restricted area
The road is disjoint from the restricted area
The road passes through the center

question.prompt: A circular restricted area has radius \(5\), and the distance from a straight road to its center is \(5\). What is the relationship between the road and the boundary of the restricted area?

solutions.explanation: The distance equals the radius, so the road is tangent to the circle, with only one point in common.
solutions.title: Compare distance with radius
